title: Sheryl Sandberg leads $10 million investment in AI-powered vehicle inspection service

thread_text:
1. Why back AI for car checks?

Manual inspections miss up to 30% of visible damage—and that’s just the start.

2. Dents you can’t see detected.

Her firm’s AI spots damage invisible to the human eye, revealing hidden issues.

4. The twist in the story.

Sandberg’s backing turns a blind spot into a tool that shifts buyer power.

5. Test it on your next car.

instagram.caption:
Manual checks miss up to 30% of visible damage on used cars—and that’s just what humans can see.

Sheryl Sandberg just led a $10 million investment in an AI service that spots dents invisible to the naked eye. Instead of trusting a seller’s word or your own glance, you get a detailed report of every hidden flaw before signing.

For anyone buying a used car, the power shift is real: the AI turns your blind spot into a tool that reveals what the seller might not mention.

Next time you test-drive, will you run the scan before you pay? 🚗
